## Checklist

- [ ] `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`, and `go test -race ./...` pass
- [ ] `gofmt -l .` prints nothing and `golangci-lint run` reports 0 issues
- [ ] Tests added/updated for behavior changes (golden tests for output/scoring)
- [ ] Conventional Commit title (e.g. `feat(checks): ...`)
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior or flags changed
